project_type: Python Flask web app - real-time drone crack detection dashboard
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, venv-based; PyInstaller for packaging
test_framework: Custom integration tests in tests/test_integration.py (unittest-style assertions, no pytest)
build_command: python -c "import app; import detector; import video_source; import capture_manager; import inference_core; import gps_provider; import inspection_db; import report_generator; import image_quality; import crack_validator"
verification_instructions: 1. Run python tests/test_integration.py and confirm ALL INTEGRATION TESTS PASSED. 2. Verify no hardcoded IPs in runtime code (grep for IP patterns excluding README.md, DEPLOY.md, comments).
setup_instructions: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu -q && pip install -r requirements.txt -q
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Docker daemon available for build verification. Tests run on host. The YOLO model file best.pt exists in the project root.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing functionality. Do not rebuild from scratch. Fix/extend existing code. No hardcoded IPs in runtime code. The IP_CAMERA_URL default is the ONLY hardcoded IP in runtime code currently.
key_patterns: Flask app in app.py with routes. Video source abstraction in video_source.py with build_registry(). Background detector thread in detector.py. Capture state machine in capture_manager.py. Tests are self-contained in tests/test_integration.py with assert-based checks. Config via env vars at module level. Frontend polls /status and /capture/status with setInterval. Dark theme CSS with CSS vars.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), detector.py, video_source.py, capture_manager.py, inference_core.py, gps_provider.py, inspection_db.py, report_generator.py, image_quality.py, crack_validator.py. templates/: dashboard.html, inspections.html. static/: style.css, js/dashboard.js, img/, sounds/. tests/: test_integration.py.
